description: Declares what cursor-portable syncs and where. The setup scripts enforce these contracts; the file is also the source of truth for the README's sync table.

sync_targets.name: MCP bridge
sync_targets.notes: Uses ${userHome} in mcp.json so paths are resolved at MCP-spawn time. node_modules is gitignored.

sync_targets.name: User skills
sync_targets.notes: Setup copies on top of existing skills; user-added skills are preserved.

explicitly_excluded.name: ~/.cursor/argv.json
explicitly_excluded.reason: Contains machine-specific crash-reporter-id UUID. Writing the same ID to every machine makes crash reports correlatable and links separate installs. Let Cursor regenerate on first launch.

explicitly_excluded.name: %APPDATA%/Cursor/User/settings.json
explicitly_excluded.reason: May contain http.proxy, machine-specific paths, account IDs. Sync selectively by editing the file and adding a partial-sync step to setup.ps1.

explicitly_excluded.name: Extensions binary
explicitly_excluded.reason: Cursor/VS Code extensions are OS-specific binaries. Use extensions.txt as a checklist and let Cursor Settings Sync handle them, or `cursor --install-extension <id>` manually.

explicitly_excluded.name: Workspace storage + conversation history
explicitly_excluded.reason: Path-keyed; recreated on first open of the same workspace.
